span.normalized: (c) In connection with the Kolpa acquisition, the Company entered into a long-term copper stream agreement with Versamet Royalties Corporation. Under the terms of the agreement, Versamet is entitled to receive a specified percentage of refined copper production from the Kolpa operation for an upfront cash payment, with ongoing deliveries priced at a fixed percentage of prevailing market prices.
